policy: Official semantic subtype bridge for current CUATM administrative UATs. CUATM supplies identity, parent/child hierarchy and status codes; Law 764/2001 art. 8 supplies the exhaustive current municipality-name set. OSM tags/admin_level are not legal subtype evidence.

sources.authority: Biroul Național de Statistică al Republicii Moldova
sources.label: CUATM current Excel
Legea nr. 764/2001 privind organizarea administrativ-teritorială, text consolidat, art. 8

status_3.rule: A CUATM status_code=3 record is classified as town only after the exhaustive municipality list is proven to resolve exactly to status_code=5 and to have zero overlap with status_code=3. Any municipality-list drift fails closed.
status_3.level_1_municipality_policy: No current status_code=3 identity may be classified as level_1_municipality under this bridge.

status_8.commune: status_code=8 with one or more direct CUATM children, all of status_code=9
status_8.independent_village: status_code=8 with zero direct CUATM children
status_8.fail_closed: Any status_code=8 child whose status_code is not 9, duplicate code, broken child reference or other unclassified structure is a blocking issue.

settlement_policy_separation: CUATM status_code 6/9 component localities are intentionally outside this bridge. Their polygon-exhaustiveness policy remains separately NOT_DETERMINED.
